title: Closed lumbermill beta, no external economy
assumptions: Permission default false; 1/5/10 explicitly admitted testers. These are scenarios, not measured activity.
1/8/60 complete workpiece rounds per tester-day; zero grant at every rate including unlimited retries.
No Vault/tokens/playerXP/inventory boards; cargo and completedRounds are local LumberState only.
No global WorksiteStatsPort completion/contribution, workday seals, network completion, enterprise or reward ledger grants.
Actual terrain unchanged; accepted virtual chopping cancels native break before drops. SELL and future SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged.
No purchases, prices, boosts or progression entitlements are introduced.

flows.source: LumberController: beta round completion is local-only; no rewards/stats/network completion or real block drops
